title: A Asset for the Safehouse
author: Sebastian Sterling
blurb: Noor Quintana, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
